national_news.title: PM Modi Calls for Concrete Goals to Strengthen Quad Cooperation
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the Quad meeting in Manila, describing it as a constructive and trusted partnership for the Indo-Pacific.
Highlighted that officials from the four member countries first met in Manila in 2007 and revived the dialogue there in 2017.
Noted that foreign ministers of Quad nations have met five times since January of the previous year, reflecting strong political will.
Emphasized cooperation areas including maritime security, trusted supply chains, emerging technologies, and disaster response.

national_news.title: 23rd ASEAN-India Summit Held in Manila
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila, Philippines, marking his 13th interaction in this format.
Highlighted that India's Act East policy and bilateral cooperation have expanded into digital technologies, defense, and space.
Noted that India and ASEAN together represent about one-fourth of the world's population, aligning ASEAN Community Vision 2045 with Viksit Bharat 2047.
Reaffirmed India's unwavering support for ASEAN unity and centrality to build a secure, inclusive, and prosperous Indo-Pacific.

national_news.title: ASEAN and India Adopt Joint Statement on Disaster Management Cooperation
bullets: Adopted the ASEAN-India Joint Statement on Cooperation in Disaster Management at the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila.
Focuses on early warning systems, emergency response, disaster preparedness, and resilient recovery against natural disasters.
Involves coordination among agencies like ACDM, AHA Centre, and India's National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA).
Agreed to implement specific activities under the ASEAN-India Plan of Action (2026-2030) using AI, machine learning, and data analytics.

national_news.title: India's Electronics Exports Surge 44% to Reach $32 Billion in H1 FY
bullets: India's electronic goods exports grew by 44 percent to around $32 billion during April-September, up from $22 billion previously.
Smartphone exports rose over 35 percent to more than $18 billion, constituting 56.8 percent of the total electronic exports basket.
Non-smartphone electronics grew over 56 percent to exceed $13 billion, indicating diversification into components, PCBs, and storage devices.
Singapore and China emerged as leading destinations for electronic parts and mounted printed circuit boards.

national_news.title: Logo and Mascot Unveiled for 8th Khelo India Youth Games in Telangana
bullets: The 8th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games will be held across six cities in Telangana from 11th to 22nd December.
The logo and mascot were jointly unveiled by Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy.
Around 8,000 athletes are expected to participate across 29 sports disciplines, comprising 27 competitive sports and two demonstration events.

national_news.title: Vice-President Highlights Significant Expansion of India's Higher Education Sector Over 12 Years
bullets: Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan stated that India's universities have increased from 760 in 2014-15 to over 1,400 at present.
During the same period, IITs increased from 16 to 23, IIMs from 13 to 22, and AIIMS from 7 to 20.
Higher education student enrollment grew substantially from 3.42 crore to over 4.5 crore students.

national_news.title: Overview of India's Comprehensive Public Health Response to COVID-19 Pandemic
bullets: India's pandemic response strategy combined central direction under national frameworks with grassroots implementation by States and local authorities from January 2020 to May 2023.
Legal and administrative authority was anchored by invoking powers under the Disaster Management Act, 2005, and the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897, alongside the formation of 11 Empowered Groups.
By December 31, 2025, 97 per cent of the population aged 12 and above received at least one vaccine dose, 90 per cent were fully vaccinated, and 22.89 crore precaution doses were administered.

national_news.title: Implementation and Significance of the Forest Rights Act, 2006
bullets: The Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006 came into force on December 31, 2007, to provide legal recognition to land and community forest rights.
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs is the nodal ministry for implementing the Act, which has distributed 25.42 lakh titles across nearly 238 lakh acres in 20 States and Jammu and Kashmir.

Eligibility requires traditional forest dwellers or OTFDs to have resided in and depended on forests for at least three generations (75 years) prior to December 13, 2005, with individual land claims capped at four hectares.

national_news.title: National Naturopathy Day and Promotion of Natural Healing Systems
bullets: India observes National Naturopathy Day annually on November 18, with the 9th edition hosted at Nagamangala, Karnataka, under the theme 'Prakrutik Chikitsa, Swasth Bharat'.
Naturopathy is promoted as a drug-free, cost-effective healing system relying on natural elements like diet, fasting, water, mud, and massage.
The National Institute of Naturopathy in Pune operates Nisarg Gram, a 250-bedded hospital featuring the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college.

national_news.title: Functional Integration of PIB and Central Bureau of Communication
bullets: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting ordered the functional integration of the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC), formerly DAVP, into the Press Information Bureau (PIB) on November 12, 2026.
The unified organization functions under the overall leadership of the Director General (Coordination), PIB, New Delhi.
The integration process is designed to be replicated step by step at state and regional branch levels to streamline government communication.

national_news.title: National Naturopathy Day and Drug-Free Healthcare Initiatives
bullets: India observes National Naturopathy Day on November 18, with the 9th edition hosted at Nagamangala, Karnataka, under the theme 'Prakrutik Chikitsa, Swasth Bharat'.
Naturopathy is a drug-free, cost-effective system utilizing diet, fasting, water, mud, and massage to promote self-healing.
The National Institute of Naturopathy, Pune, operates Nisarg Gram, featuring a 250-bedded hospital and the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches 'Ganna Vikas Rath-2026' to Promote Sugarcane Cultivation
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched the 'Ganna Vikas Rath-2026' from the Secretariat in Patna, organized by the Sugarcane Industries Department.
The state currently has 10 operational sugar mills, with 5 more set to begin operations soon to revive the rural economy and boost farmers' income.
The initiative aims to educate farmers on modern agricultural techniques, sugarcane mechanization subsidies, and digital tools like the 'Ganna ID' and 'Ganna Sathi' AI chatbot.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister to Inaugurate 19.76-km Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur Six-Lane Bridge 'Nitish Setu' in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the 19.76-km six-lane bridge named 'Nitish Setu' over the Ganga on November 21, 2026.
The bridge connects Kachchi Dargah in Patna district to Bidupur in Vaishali district via Raghopur Diara, implemented by BSRDCL with construction by L&T and Daewoo.
The project's total approved cost is Rs 4,988.40 crore, featuring financial assistance of USD 450.84 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Proposes Two New Sugar Mills in Motipur and Saran
bullets: The Bihar government has proposed setting up two new sugar mills at Motipur (Muzaffarpur) and Taraiya (Saran).
Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) have been initiated to assess technical and financial feasibility.
The initiative aims to support sugarcane farmers, reduce transportation costs, generate employment, and revive Bihar's sugar industry.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches 'Sankalp Sandhya' Programme for Free Evening Classes
bullets: The Bihar Education Department launched 'Sankalp Sandhya' to provide free evening classes for academically weak students in Classes 9 to 12.
Classes will run daily from 5 pm to 7:30 pm across selected government schools in all 38 district headquarters until March 31, 2027.
The curriculum covers five subjects: English, Mathematics, Science, Computer Science, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).

bihar_news.title: Pathways Plus Initiative Bridges Digital Divide in Bihar
bullets: Sumair Kandhari's digital education initiative 'Pathways Plus', launched in 2023, has reached over 1,700 students and 750 women in Bihar.
The program was developed in partnership with KCS Foundation India and features a computer laboratory established in Samastipur with 20 workstations.
Pathways Plus provides structured training in computer skills, Python programming, and artificial intelligence (AI) to underserved rural students.

bihar_news.title: Northeast Frontier Railway Achieves 100% Electrification Across Jurisdiction
bullets: The Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) announced 100% railway electrification across its jurisdiction in North-East India within a decade, totaling 4,311.96 route kilometres (RKM).

The electrification initiative began in 2017-18 to modernize infrastructure and promote greener transportation, with Assam accounting for the largest share at 2,546.04 RKM and Bihar contributing 427.49 RKM.
Recent milestones include the completion of electrification in the Lumding-Badarpur section on September 14, 2026, and the Bairabi-Sairang section in Mizoram on October 12, 2026.

bihar_news.title: RailTel Secures Major Orders for Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in Bihar
bullets: RailTel Corporation of India secured a major work order worth Rs 57.49 crore from the Bihar State Educational Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited.
The project involves developing hybrid Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in colleges and universities across Bihar under the PM-USHA Scheme.
Additional orders include a Rs 50.62 crore project from the Bihar Education Project Council (BEPC) for vocational education under Samagra Shiksha.
